summary: The diff implements all three major requirements. REQ-1 (HomePage redesign with compact banner, product grid immediately after, MobileRechargeSection at bottom) is fully addressed. REQ-2 (2-column product grid, styled ProductCard, Coming Soon empty state) is fully addressed. REQ-3 (sticky BottomNavBar with 4 tabs, WhatsApp FAB, bottom padding, hidden on admin pages) is fully addressed. One minor gap: the image asset for coming-soon.dim_400x300.png is referenced but not shown as added. Overall implementation is comprehensive.

missing_requirements.requirement: Colorful 'Coming Soon' illustration image asset (coming-soon.dim_400x300.png) must be provided/added
missing_requirements.reason: The diff references '/assets/generated/coming-soon.dim_400x300.png' in ProductGrid.tsx but no image asset file is shown as added in the diff. The image is listed as a required asset in the build request.

hallucinated_features.description: Placeholder pages created for Search, My Orders, and Wallet (SearchPage.tsx, MyOrdersPage.tsx, WalletPage.tsx) with routes registered in App.tsx
hallucinated_features.reason: While REQ-3 mentions Search, My Orders, and Wallet as nav placeholders, the build request non-goals explicitly state these are nav placeholders only with no full implementation required. Creating dedicated page components and routes goes slightly beyond what was strictly requested, though it is functionally reasonable for nav links to have destinations.
